授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This course offers an introduction to mathematical logic with propositional logic as the central framework. Students will study the formal syntax and semantics of logical languages, the notion of logical consequence, and proof-theoretic methods. Particular emphasis is placed on the formalization of natural language, especially declarative sentences, by translating them into propositional formulas and analyzing their logical structure. Through this perspective, the course demonstrates how abstract logical notions support precise reasoning and the rigorous analysis of meaning.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: To introduce students to propositional logic and enable them to formalize and rigorously analyze reasoning by translating natural language statements into precise logical structures.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: propositional logic, formal reasoning, proof rules
